tagline: NLN500a based Arduino Nano-compatible LoRa evaluation kit with USB-C and Arduino IDE support.
meta_desc: Nebulae NLN0651-i LoRa Arduino-compatible EVK — NLN500a (STM32WL) node board, Arduino Nano pinout, USB-C, Arduino IDE programming, EU863-870/US902-928/IN865, up to 10 km LoS.
desc: NLN0651-i is an NLN500a (STM32WL) SoC-based, compact LoRa node board with an Arduino Nano-compatible design that supports Arduino IDE programming for easy, open-source software development. The evaluation kit is designed to help beginners, developers and students learn LoRa and IoT technology quickly and turn proofs-of-concept into practical applications.

overview: The Arduino EVK, or evaluation kit, featuring LoRa technology is designed to help beginners, developers and students learn LoRa and IoT technology quickly. It helps users turn their idea or proof-of-concept into a practical application and make the IoT a reality; it is easy to program, create and connect your things everywhere.

NLN0651-i is built on the NLN500a (STM32WL) SoC and is a compact LoRa-based node board with an Arduino Nano-compatible design that supports Arduino IDE programming, ensuring easy, open-source software development. It is best suited to LoRa IoT sensor-node solutions for smart cities and other LoRaWAN applications, and is ideal where low cost and low power consumption are required.

The board includes basic examples and library support for Arduino and STM, an inbuilt programmer that works with the Arduino IDE over USB, LED indication for LoRa communication and power detection, and a U.FL antenna connector. The kit ships with a braided USB Type-C cable and a helical antenna.
